PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength — Beginner"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with bodyweight"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Full body A":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row  <-- invalid exercise name omitted
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower & Core":
        warmup:
          hip_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full body B":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 3x1..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lunge 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
